# Webhooks

Build a service that Monark notifies when something happens in your organization, such as a record created or a role assigned. An admin registers your URL and chooses the events in [Webhooks](../../administer/integrations/webhooks.md); these pages cover the receiving end.

- [Receive webhook deliveries](receive-deliveries.md): accept deliveries, skip duplicates and test locally.
- [Verify webhook signatures](verify-signatures.md): check each delivery came from Monark before acting on it.
